scope: Prompt-first target-only GenMol generation; optional supplied-candidate screening

browser.input: Prompt-only input and privacy approval verified with real local OPF; no uploaded data or target selector
browser.routing: Optional public dataset switches to screening; clearing it switches to generation
browser.responsive: Desktop and 390px inspected; narrow document clientWidth=scrollWidth=375
browser.recovery: Browser refresh reconnected to the same active generation run
browser.results: Generation provenance, partial-result notice, 20-candidate evidence table and unchanged discovery shortlist inspected

live.reference: live passed; excluded from generated shortlist
live.assistant_explanation: Exact model identity verified; narrative is non-authoritative. Follow-up review recognized both discovery failures but misstated not-shortlisted count; final adapter additionally supplies exact policy category counts.

limitations: Only the prepared human ABL1 target executes; other targets require preparation.
Generated candidates have no measured efficacy or safety outcomes.
Supplied-candidate mode retains the frozen reference requirement.
Hosted latency is variable; the first planning attempt reached the 120-second timeout.
Two fresh candidate Boltz-2 requests did not produce usable evidence. They remain failed/unranked in the partial report; no automatic retries or replacements.
